messages:
zoe-sales: Quick escalation — NovaDiagnostics POC is intermittently getting 429s across completions and embeddings during a live demo. Demo in 45m.
matt-support: Which endpoints, sample response, and concurrency they9re using?
zoe-sales: They9re hitting /v1/completions and /v1/embeddings from a browser front-end + CI harness with ~28 concurrent workers. Sample 429 (redacted):\n```json\n{\n  \"error\": \"rate_limit_exceeded\",\n  \"code\": \"per_tenant_token_burn\",\n  \"route\": \"/v1/completions\",\n  \"message\": \"temporary token burn limit\"\n}\n```\nmatt-support: Error code suggests a token burn-rate guard, but they also reported per-route 429s with Retry-After sometimes present and sometimes missing.
raja-eng: Two mechanisms likely colliding: short-term token throughput guard + per-route burst/rps limiter. If a single tenant runs many concurrent requests across routes you can see both. Missing Retry-After is an endpoint edge-case but we should fix that later. For now, two remediation paths: 1) temporary token throughput bump + per-route burst increase for demo window, or 2) ask client to throttle concurrency, batch embeddings, and use streaming.
kira-oncall: I can apply a temporary allowance: +120k tokens/sec for 2h and bump /v1/completions burst to 2k for 2h. Need sales approval.
zoe-sales: Approve both. We9ll mark them temporary and tell the customer to optimize after the demo.
quota-bot: Quota change requested: tenant=novadiag-poc, route=/v1/completions, burst=2000, duration=7200s, id=Q-186999-33
quota-bot: Token throughput change requested: tenant=novadiag-poc, delta=120000 tokens/sec, duration=7200s, id=TB-186999-33
quota-bot: Changes applied. Expires at 1870007199.
raja-eng: Before demo, send them a short mitigation checklist: 1) set client max_concurrency <= 10; 2) reuse HTTP keep-alive; 3) prefer streaming for responses >150 tokens; 4) batch small embedding calls; 5) implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After when present and apply full jitter otherwise.
matt-support: Also clarify billing confusion: they thought demo traffic would be outside token commit calculations. Confirmed: demo traffic counts toward tenant token pool; we can arrange a temporary token allowance but monthly commit remains.
zoe-sales: I9ll forward the checklist and note the temporary lift. Please monitor for 15m and ping if 429s continue.
kira-oncall: Monitoring now  5m after change: 0 429s and token burn within temporary allowance. Will auto-revert at expiry. Filing a follow-up presales quota if they want sustained throughput.
zoe-sales: Demo finished and customer reported no 429s. Following up with presales request and optimization tips. Thanks all! :tada:
